scenario: [RLOW.6.1.10]: on integer storage `x::<unit>` of a tier-1 unit with an offset is `P·x + R` when Q = 1. `off` is `x * 8 + 1` bits, so P = 8, Q = 1, R = 1. A fact holding 2 is `2::off`, 17 bits, so the rule logs. A lowering that drops the offset gives 16 bits and stays silent. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.rlow_6_1_10_int`'s `R` term, evaluated by each runtime.
rules_ds:
unit dimension data storage int64 base bit
unit bit: data
unit off: data = x * 8 + 1

schema S scope logical:
    id: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule conv:
    S s where s.n::off == 17_bit
->
    log info "conv"
